summary: Re-verified 4 tests from iter 111 after fix to /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/user/[id].tsx useEffect (early-return on me===null, setError(null) before ghost branch) and addition of testID='menu-block' to full-profile menu row. RESULTS: (1) Ghost view on already-blocked profile — PASS: navigating chat_a → /user/user_16f709708760 with block established renders testID `public-blocked`, 'UTENTE BLOCCATO' title, ban icon, @chatUserB nickname, and red 'SBLOCCA' button (testID `unblock-btn`). No photos/badges/history/circle elements present. (2) Unblock from ghost view — PASS: tapping unblock-btn calls DELETE /api/users/user_16f709708760/block (backend returns empty blocked_users), ghost view exits, full public profile mounts showing @chatUserB card with MESSAGGIO / AGGIUNGI actions. (3) Menu block from full profile — PASS: user-menu opens, `menu-block` testID is now present in full-profile menu (label 'Blocca utente'), tapping opens the BLOCCA confirmation modal with `block-confirm-yes`, confirming triggers block and transitions to ghost view end-to-end. (4) Reply-draft regression — PASS: on feud_198672d881cc side B with 2 comments (cmt_e6c95638b7be by chat_a and cmt_318cede6df83 by chatUserB), typing 'test draft A' in reply-input for A then switching to B shows empty B input, and reopening A also shows empty input. Feud page refetch-on-focus was implicitly exercised (comments loaded correctly on tab-b activation). All iter 111 blockers resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified: [id].tsx:92 `if (me === null) return;` prevents the me-null race; the effect re-runs when me updates and the block-guard now fires before publicUser(). The setError(null) at line 93 also correctly clears any residual error before the next attempt.
menu-block testID at [id].tsx:840 is now consistent across ghost view and full-profile menu — automated block/unblock tests can now target either view uniformly.
